major_cooldowns.name: Dancing Rune Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every 90 seconds, always after Reaper's Mark, and line it up with burn phases together with a potion; never sit on it longer than 15 seconds for its parry.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id. Guide states Reaper's Mark and Dancing Rune Weapon align every 90 seconds; tooltip base is 120s. Duration 12s with Everlasting Bond, 8s base. Aura id is 81256.

major_cooldowns.name: Reaper's Mark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Deathbringer only: cast on cooldown with Death and Decay already ticking under the target, and always immediately before Dancing Rune Weapon so the rune weapons do not waste duplicated casts.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id, not pressed in the sampled San'layn parse. Reaper's Onslaught cuts the 45s base to 30s.

major_cooldowns.name: Consumption
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Empower to rank 1 and press it on cooldown while Dancing Rune Weapon is down; skip it when Blood Plague has more than 40 seconds left and no Dance of Midnight proc is active.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id, not pressed in the sampled parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Raise Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it off the global on cooldown, macroed with Reaper's Mark in the opener as Deathbringer.

major_cooldowns.name: Death and Decay
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-place it before the pull with no target selected, keep its buff up whenever you are fighting 4 or more targets, spend every Crimson Scourge proc with it, and get it ticking under the target before Reaper's Mark.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id; the standing buff aura is 188290.

defensives.name: Vampiric Blood
defensives.usage_rule: Plan it onto a specific hit for 30% extra maximum health and 30% increased healing received, and cast Anti-Magic Shell or Tombstone under it since those shields stay 30% larger after it fades.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Save its 30% flat reduction for pre-planned tank busters, stun mechanics, and any ability that scales off raw damage taken before absorbs and self-healing.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Time it onto the magic hit whose debuff you want to avoid, since a full absorb blocks the application, and make sure incidental magic damage is not eating the shell first.
defensives.id_note: Cast id. Anti-Magic Barrier cuts the 60s base to 40s and extends the 5s duration by 40%.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Press it for the 10 second Charm, Fear and Sleep immunity; the added Leech is a bonus, not the reason.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it on planned magic raid damage and count it in your own cooldown plan: it is a 15% magic reduction for you as well as the group.

defensives.name: Death Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency heal for 50% of your maximum health; it absorbs incoming healing for 15 seconds afterwards, so do not press it into a window where you need the healers.

defensives.name: Tombstone
defensives.usage_rule: Burn 5 Bone Shield charges for a 30% maximum health absorb, ideally under Vampiric Blood, and only when you can rebuild the charges straight after.

rules.description: Death's Caress into Dancing Rune Weapon at the pull
rules.action: Pre-place Death and Decay with no target selected, open with Death's Caress just before the pull for 2 Bone Shield charges and instant Blood Plague, then send Dancing Rune Weapon.

rules.description: Reaper's Mark before Dancing Rune Weapon
rules.action: The two align every 90 seconds: cast Reaper's Mark first, then Dancing Rune Weapon, so you do not waste duplicated casts.

rules.description: Death and Decay before Reaper's Mark
rules.action: Get Death and Decay ticking under the target before Reaper's Mark; it is the largest guaranteed source of stacks before the mark detonates.

rules.description: Bone Shield kept up by Marrowrend and Death's Caress
rules.action: Never let the 30 second buff lapse: refresh with Marrowrend below 6 charges, or Death's Caress when you are out of melee range, and stay at 5 or more charges for the Ossuary discount.
Press Death Strike before Coagulopathy expires to keep the stack rolling; each of its 4 stacks adds 10% Blood Plague damage over 15 seconds.

rules.description: Death Strike spent at high Runic Power
rules.action: Spend Death Strike above 70 Runic Power, or earlier when you need the heal or Coagulopathy is about to fade; never idle near the cap.

rules.description: Crimson Scourge procs spent on Death and Decay
rules.action: Dump every Crimson Scourge proc into a free Death and Decay; inside Gift of the San'layn hold it until Visceral Strength has dropped.

rules.description: Vampiric Strike pressed on every proc
rules.action: Press the converted Heart Strike as soon as the proc lands: it refreshes Essence of the Blood Queen and extends Blood Plague by 3 seconds through Infliction of Sorrow.

source_summary: Blood is built around a 90 second Dancing Rune Weapon window that carries both hero trees: Deathbringer opens Reaper's Mark into Dancing Rune Weapon with Death and Decay already ticking, while San'layn treats the Gift of the San'layn window as a near-pure Death Strike and Vampiric Strike chain after a single Blood Boil. Around it the priority is maintenance and proc spending: Bone Shield at 5 or more charges, Coagulopathy refreshed by Death Strike above 70 Runic Power, Crimson Scourge dumped into a free Death and Decay, and Consumption empowered to rank 1 whenever the rune weapon is down. Defensive cooldowns are planned per mechanic rather than pressed reactively, with Vampiric Blood inflating Anti-Magic Shell and Tombstone shields cast under it and Icebound Fortitude reserved for raw damage-taken mechanics.
